ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful
Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak
From the evil of what He has created

ayahs.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness
And from the evil of the witchcraft when they blow in the knots

ayahs.transliteration: Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of the envier when he envies
